description: This file defines the SubstitutionStrategy interface, which specifies a strategy for placeholder substitution in command headers of type WithDittoHeaders within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for checking applicability and applying substitution using a specified algorithm.

classes.name: SubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: Defines a contract for strategies that determine how placeholders in command headers are substituted, applicable to commands of type WithDittoHeaders.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if this substitution strategy applies to the provided WithDittoHeaders instance.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs placeholder substitution on the given WithDittoHeaders using the specified HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithm.
